/* AnnouncementMapper.selectAnnouncementList */ SELECT cap.ann_no , cap.board_no , cbi.board_nm , cbi.board_ty_cd , cap.ttl , cap.cn , cap.wrtr_id , cap.top_fix_yn , TO_CHAR(cap.pblanc_bgng_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS pblanc_bgng_dt , TO_CHAR(cap.pblanc_end_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS pblanc_end_dt , TO_CHAR(cap.rcrt_bgng_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS rcrt_bgng_dt , TO_CHAR(cap.rcrt_end_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS rcrt_end_dt , TO_CHAR(cap.reg_dttm, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_dttm , TO_CHAR(cap.mdf_dttm, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS mdf_dttm , cap.inq_cnt , cap.del_yn , cap.atch_file_id , cap.opn_yn FROM center_ann_board_post cap LEFT JOIN center_board_instance cbi ON cap.board_no = cbi.board_no WHERE NVL(cap.del_yn, 'N') = 'N'
AND LOWER(cap.ttl) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{searchTtl}) || '%'
AND cap.rcrt_bgng_dt >= TO_DATE(#{searchFrom}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND cap.rcrt_end_dt <= TO_DATE(#{searchTo}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND ( (#{searchStatus} = '예정' AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) < TRUNC(cap.rcrt_bgng_dt)) OR (#{searchStatus} = '진행중' AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(cap.rcrt_bgng_dt) AND TRUNC(cap.rcrt_end_dt)) OR (#{searchStatus} = '마감' AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) > TRUNC(cap.rcrt_end_dt)) )
ORDER BY cap.reg_dttm DESC

/* AnnouncementMapper.selectAnnouncement */ SELECT cap.ann_no , cap.board_no , cbi.board_nm , cbi.board_ty_cd , cap.ttl , cap.cn , cap.wrtr_id , cap.top_fix_yn , TO_CHAR(cap.pblanc_bgng_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS pblanc_bgng_dt , TO_CHAR(cap.pblanc_end_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS pblanc_end_dt , TO_CHAR(cap.rcrt_bgng_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS rcrt_bgng_dt , TO_CHAR(cap.rcrt_end_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS rcrt_end_dt , TO_CHAR(cap.reg_dttm, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_dttm , TO_CHAR(cap.mdf_dttm, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS mdf_dttm , cap.inq_cnt , cap.del_yn , cap.atch_file_id , cap.opn_yn FROM center_ann_board_post cap LEFT JOIN center_board_instance cbi ON cap.board_no = cbi.board_no WHERE cap.ann_no = #{annNo} AND NVL(cap.del_yn, 'N') = 'N'
mapper.insert: /* AnnouncementMapper.insertAnnouncement */ INSERT INTO center_ann_board_post ( ann_no , board_no , ttl , cn , wrtr_id , top_fix_yn , pblanc_bgng_dt , pblanc_end_dt , rcrt_bgng_dt , rcrt_end_dt , reg_dttm , inq_cnt , del_yn , atch_file_id , opn_yn ) VALUES ( 'ANN' || LPAD(( SELECT NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(ann_no, 4))), 0) + 1 FROM center_ann_board_post WHERE ann_no LIKE 'ANN%' ), 12, '0') , ( SELECT MIN(board_no) FROM center_board_instance WHERE NVL(use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' ) , #{ttl} , #{cn} , #{wrtrId} , NVL(#{topFixYn}, 'N') , TO_DATE(#{pblancBgngDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') , TO_DATE(#{pblancEndDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') , TO_DATE(#{rcrtBgngDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') , TO_DATE(#{rcrtEndDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') , SYSDATE , 0 , 'N' , #{atchFileId} , 'Y' )
